reference_producer: Actual Chrono baseline with the upstream fixed ChAssemblyAnalysis.cpp replacing the defective translation unit; no other solver implementation is used to produce reference.h5.
scope: Source-repair task for center-of-mass distance constraints only. The separate ChSystem.cpp step-restoration fix is outside the task and does not affect these instantaneous outputs.
case_origin: Author-designed controlled variants of the issue mechanism and official regression families; coupled graph cases are adaptations, not copies of the original issue input.
independent_validation: Differentiate exact distance constraints analytically, solve the resulting mass-weighted constraint equations, compare all published observables. This is an independent mathematical check, not another upstream numerical producer.
